472297.overview:
This is a simple 15-Puzzle, with images of Hatsune MIku. You have to sort all the pieces until you get the final image.

• On title screen, Press Z or X to start the game.
• Use arrow keys to move the pieces.
• Press X to open the game's menu, and Z to select an option.

478692.overview:
This is a very basic minigolf game developed for the Indie Game Dev Beginners Game Jam.
Drag with left mouse button or touch screen and release to push the ball. Hold right mouse button to zoom out and get an overview of the level.
Press R to reset.
